title: Optimal Regulation and Information Institutions with Hidden Network Equilibria
abstract: arXiv:2611.13715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggregate outcomes can conceal network configurations that expose households to uninsurable risk and require different public services. We study a regulator's joint choice of a corrective activity charge and an information institution in a two-population network game. Although aggregate behavior follows an exact stable law, distinct specialization equilibria require different targeted interventions. With purchased Gaussian monitoring, primitive conditions imply a discontinuous switch between strong regulation without purchased information and informed specialization. The regulator may alternatively obtain signed certification or elicit a privately known state through a report backed by committed random audits. We characterize the three institutions' optimized values and the cost thresholds at which credible disclosure replaces government monitoring. translated_title: 隐藏网络均衡下的最优监管与信息制度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.13715v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：总体结果可能掩盖了使家庭暴露于不可保险风险并需要不同公共服务的网络配置。我们在一个双群体网络博弈中研究监管者对矫正性活动收费与信息制度的联合选择。尽管总体行为遵循精确的稳定规律，不同的专业化均衡却需要不同的针对性干预。在购买高斯监测的情形下，基本条件意味着“不购买信息的强监管”与“知情专业化”之间存在不连续的切换。监管者也可以选择获取签署认证，或通过有承诺随机审计支持的自报机制来引出私人已知的状态。我们刻画了这三种制度各自的优化价值，以及可信披露在何种成本阈值上取代政府监测。制度的选择还会改变最优监管：即使当认证与真……
tldr: 该论文在一个双群体网络博弈中研究了监管者如何联合选择矫正性收费与信息制度（购买高斯监测、签署认证或随机审计支持的自报），刻画了三种制度的优化价值及其相互替代的成本阈值，并揭示总体行为背后隐藏的网络专业化均衡需要不同的针对性干预。
en_tdlr: This paper studies a regulator's joint choice of corrective charges and information institutions (purchased Gaussian monitoring, signed certification, or audit-backed self-reports) in a two-population network game, characterizing each institution's optimized value and the cost thresholds at which credible disclosure replaces government monitoring, while showing that hidden network specialization equilibria behind aggregate behavior require different targeted interventions.
